title: Contractible homotopy fibers detect equivalences of spaces
statement: Use spaces, weak equivalences, contractibility and homotopy fibers as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $f:P\to Q$ be a map of small Kan complexes. Then $f$ is a weak homotopy equivalence if and only if, for every vertex $q\in Q$, the homotopy fiber $P\times_{Q,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,Q)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,Q}\{q\}$ is contractible. In particular, every homotopy fiber of an equivalence of spaces is contractible; this assertion concerns homotopy fibers and not ordinary set-theoretic fibers.
